rationale: With a unanimous vote and the Chief assigning, Roberts is most likely to keep the opinion narrow and institutional, reversing the Second Circuit for grafting a retaliatory-intent element onto AIR21’s incorporated contributing-factor framework. Kagan is the main alternative given her structural/statutory-scheme emphasis, while a few Justices (especially Gorsuch/Alito/Thomas) have some chance of separate concurrences to underscore textualism and separation-of-powers or to caution about the evidentiary content of “contributing factor.”
